entities.name: José Eduardo Agualusa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Eduardo Agualusa Alves da Cunha is an Angolan writer and columnist of Portuguese and Brazilian descent. He studied agronomy and silviculture in Lisbon, Portugal. Currently he resides in the Island of Mozambique, working as a writer and journalist. He also has been working to establish a public library on the island.
